digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, Jira reconciler, CLI routing
propositions: Five recovered RP-02 through RP-06 implementation decisions contain approved-but-ambiguous architectural intent and hard-won behavior that must be resolved with evidence before becoming implementation stories.
RP-02 binding-store recovery requires ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary to resolve multi-file atomicity versus fail-closed intent.

RP-03 outbound lifecycle protocol calls need scoped finite-pass fuse thresholds, bounded retry envelopes, and commit_unknown handling to distinguish transient provider failures from permanent configuration failures.

RP-04 configured versus ambient tracker ownership, all bypass call sites, and split-context failure scenarios must map to a centralized operation-snapshot authority and backward-compatible environment precedence.

RP-05 CLI routing responsibilities and RP-06 plan-review policy ownership require explicit effective-applicability semantics, checkpoint failure classification, and retry lineage contracts to distinguish behavioral changes from refactors.
